name: Do I need to remove old flooring before new installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to remove old flooring before new installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: In most cases, yes, old flooring should be removed before new installation. This ensures a proper, level subfloor, which is crucial for the longevity and performance of your new flooring. Installing new flooring over existing layers can create an uneven surface, lead to squeaks, or compromise the stability of the new material. There are exceptions, such as installing certain luxury vinyl planks directly over existing, well-secured vinyl or tile, but a proper assessment is always recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Generally, old flooring should be removed to ensure a proper, level subfloor for new installation, though some exceptions exist depending on the new material.
